correctness.rationale: For any k-vertex deletion set S of the 18-vertex cubic 27-edge graph, forest edge count implies 2k=9+e(S)+c≥10; equality k=5 forces deleted set independent and its complement a tree. Independently constructed the exact LCF edge set and checked all C(18,5)=8568 labeled subsets for complement acyclicity, yielding exactly 252 minimum sets. Independently enumerated every one-deletion/one-insertion neighbor pair; obtained 630 exchange edges, all degrees 5, components of orders 216 and six times 6, with each size-6 component K6. BFS over every vertex of the 216 component reproduced radius 6, diameter 7, the 108/108 eccentricity split, two exact distance vectors (1,5,14,37,56,71,32,0) and (1,5,14,36,52,69,37,2), and 108 diameter pairs. Pure bipartition states count 36 and exactly fill six small components. Parsed the actual complete_certificate.json two graph-automorphism generators and independently closed their subgroup to exactly 216 permutations. Completeness of finite enumeration follows because all 8568 possible k=5 subsets and every possible swap were explicitly checked; no infinite inference is made.
residual_risks: This is a complete finite census for one named graph, not an all-cubic classification. The verified group of order 216 is only a subgroup, not a claim about the full automorphism group.
